reasons.UNRESOLVABLE: graded as undecidable — identity unresolved, no reference price, or the price source disagreed with the record

reasons.GRADED_BEFORE_HORIZON: graded on or before the date its horizon elapsed
reasons.HORIZON_INCONSISTENT: resolve_after does not follow from created_at and horizon_days
reasons.DATA_AFTER_CREATION: data_as_of is later than the call — future information
reasons.MIXED_PRICE_BASIS: return measured from a raw recorded price to an adjusted close, on an instrument that can pay distributions, with no same-series regrade available
reasons.DUPLICATE_EVENT: a repeat assertion of an event already counted
